verdict.rationale: Attio's first-party docs say its data model lets you define custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types, separate from the standard people, companies and deals objects. Marketing pages add custom fields and linking objects through a graph model, and the App SDK GraphQL API and the OpenAPI spec cover custom records and objects. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of relationship/record-reference attribute types (only marketing-level 'link objects' claims), explicit documentation of creating custom objects and attributes programmatically via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
